delta.before: Envoyer rouvre dans votre dossier personnel…

meaning_check.english: Send to reopen in your home folder…
meaning_check.context: Sending reopens the ended session in the user's home folder on the computer; keep the ellipsis and 36-cell budget.
meaning_check.bare_verb: Acceptable concise French: the ended-session context supplies the implicit subject; an explicit la would be smoother but is not grammatically required.
meaning_check.parenthetical: Not equivalent to 'in your home folder': removing dans votre detaches the location from the reopening and removes the possessor; dossier personnel can read as a personal/project folder rather than the home directory.

byte_character_count_method.method: JSON-decode the value; count terminal cells as 2 for East Asian W/F and 1 for other printable characters; assert no combining/control characters. U+2026 counts as one cell. UTF-8 bytes are reported separately and are not the width metric.

current_report_verdict.verdict_reason: SH-01 remains MAJOR: 35-cell value now fits, but the ownerless parenthetical no longer clearly says reopening occurs in your home folder and can denote a personal/project folder.

findings.problem: The detached dossier personnel parenthetical is not a grammatical destination and lacks 'your home'; personal/project-folder ambiguity remains. Formal personnel alone does not fix the clarity defect.

replacement_to_ship.reason: Formal and concise; la refers to the session and dans ~ unambiguously identifies the user's home directory as the reopening destination. Keeps the ellipsis and stays well inside budget.
replacement_to_ship.comparison: Current formal wording is better in register but worse than the old version in destination/possessive clarity. Neither parenthetical is preferred over the explicit dans ~ construction.
